title: Chief Economists Outlook
text:
Go to seriesAgenda DialoguesChief Economists OutlookThe global economy continues to navigate a period of significant disruption, with ongoing conflicts in multiple regions, volatile bond markets and growing debate over the infrastructure, technologies and investments that could shape the future.How are companies adapting to these shifts and what trends are leading economists watching most closely?This is a briefing on the latest edition of the World Economic Forum's Chief Economists Outlook.
